verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA25349140 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318573 (dated 2025-11-04). One line: item 00010, CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, 8,000 pcs at 6.11 USD, confirmed for 2025-12-04. Terms are EXW Boise with NET30 payment. No handwriting or corrections.
red_flags: Terms wording is internally inconsistent: Incoterms are EXW Boise and DDP is stated as not agreed, yet the note says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally arranges and pays for these, so the invoice could carry extra charges beyond the unit price.
The order line has no stated unit of measure and no line total.
The document has no issue date. The only dates are the order date (2025-11-04) and the confirmed delivery date (2025-12-04).
observations: Clean typed PDF with no handwriting, stamps, strike-throughs or signatures.
The description wraps over three lines in the table (Game Card 64 / GB – Grand / Heist 5).
The confirmed quantity is not separately stated. The Qty column is the only quantity shown, so it is recorded as quantity_ordered.
